title: core: SIMD-accelerated level traversal and depth aggregation in TokenBook
body:
### Problem
`TokenBook::bid_depth_between` iterates over a `HashMap<Decimal, Decimal>` using software decimal arithmetic on every price change event. Under high-throughput feeds, hash map lookups cause CPU cache misses.

### Proposal
Represent top-32 order book levels as flat contiguous arrays of fixed-point prices and quantities. Implement AVX2 / NEON SIMD vector comparison to filter price intervals and sum depth in single vector passes.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Benchmark in `benches/orderbook.rs` shows >= 3x speedup
- Passes all existing unit tests and `tests/e2e.rs`

title: core: real-time private user WebSocket execution channel integration
body:
### Problem
Polyfarmer currently connects only to the public market book WebSocket. It is blind to fills in real-time; order fills are only inferred asynchronously when cancelling or polling the Data API.

### Proposal
Connect to Polymarket's authenticated user WebSocket feed (`/ws/user`). Parse live `fill` and `execution` messages, transition order status to `Filled` in sub-millisecond time, and immediately trigger inventory tracking.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Real-time fill event triggers immediate status transition
- Avoids duplicate order placement after fill

title: security: formal verification of TokenBook and Quoter invariants using Kani
body:
### Problem
Unit tests check discrete price cases, but cannot prove the absence of integer overflow, division by zero, or negative price targets across all possible 64-bit inputs.

### Proposal
Write bounded model checking proofs using the Kani Rust Verifier (`#[kani::proof]`) for `TokenBook::snap_to_tick` and `quoter::evaluate` proving target price is strictly positive and never exceeds best bid.

### Acceptance Criteria
- `cargo kani` verifies proofs with zero counterexamples

title: security: memory safety and undefined behavior verification with Miri in CI
body:
### Problem
Cryptographic routines and zeroize drops execute pointer arithmetic that could violate LLVM strict provenance under edge cases.

### Proposal
Configure a dedicated Miri verification job in CI running with `-Zmiri-tree-borrows -Zmiri-strict-provenance` over `creds.rs` and `fsutil.rs`.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Clean Miri execution without provenance or aliasing errors

title: core: deterministic lock-free order state machine with crossbeam-channel
body:
### Problem
`AppState` is currently wrapped in a global `Arc<RwLock<AppState>>`. High-frequency lock contention between the 30s timer, WS events, and web dashboard causes lock waits.

### Proposal
Refactor engine state into an actor-based lock-free message passing architecture using bounded SPSC/MPMC channels. Quoting decisions occur sequentially on a dedicated single-threaded pinned actor.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Eliminates `RwLock` contention on hot pricing path
- End-to-end latency reduced under high event load

title: core: continuous fuzz testing harness with cargo-fuzz and libFuzzer
body:
### Problem
Malicious or malformed WebSocket payloads could trigger panics or out-of-memory errors in JSON parsing or orderbook delta processing.

### Proposal
Implement `fuzz/fuzz_targets/fuzz_ws_message.rs` using `cargo-fuzz` and `arbitrary::Arbitrary` to continuously fuzz WebSocket message parsing.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Fuzzer executes 1,000,000 iterations without crash or unhandled panic

title: security: SLSA Level 3 build provenance and Cosign keyless signing
body:
### Problem
Release binaries lack cryptographic proof of origin. Users cannot verify that binaries were compiled directly from tagged source code.

### Proposal
Implement `.github/workflows/release.yml` with `actions/attest-build-provenance` and Sigstore Cosign keyless signing via ambient GitHub OIDC tokens.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Generated binaries verified with `gh attestation verify` and `cosign verify-blob`

title: core: zero-downtime multi-wallet account switching architecture
body:
### Problem
Polyfarmer currently supports only one wallet at a time and requires a full process restart to switch accounts.

### Proposal
Refactor `Executor` to support multiple isolated wallet contexts simultaneously, enabling switching accounts or farming across multiple wallets without process restart.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Switching wallets cancels orders on old account and starts new engine without restart

title: core: deterministic instruction count performance regression gating with CodSpeed
body:
### Problem
Standard microbenchmarks in GitHub Actions suffer from CPU throttling noise, making automated performance regression detection impossible.

### Proposal
Integrate CodSpeed into CI to gate pull requests on deterministic CPU instruction counts ($I_r$) and heap allocations.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Fails PR if critical quoting functions show > 3% instruction regression

title: engine: MEV and latency protection: private transaction submission RPC
body:
### Problem
Submitting transactions over public Polygon RPC nodes can expose wallet actions to mempool frontrunning.

### Proposal
Integrate support for private RPC relays (e.g. FastLane / MEV-Blocker) for on-chain interactions.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Transactions routed via private RPC when configured

title: security: hardware wallet (Ledger / Trezor) signing support via EIP-712
body:
### Problem
Users holding substantial capital refuse to paste plaintext private keys on disk, even when encrypted.

### Proposal
Integrate HID transport for Ledger hardware wallets to sign EIP-712 order structures directly on hardware.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Orders signed via connected Ledger device

title: engine: multi-market portfolio-level correlation and risk modeling
body:
### Problem
Quoting multiple correlated markets (e.g. 'Will Fed cut by 25bps' and 'Will Fed cut by 50bps') can double portfolio exposure.

### Proposal
Implement cross-market condition correlation matrix that caps aggregate capital exposure across mutually dependent markets.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Prevents cumulative exposure on correlated condition IDs

title: core: differential mutation testing pipeline with cargo-mutants in CI
body:
### Problem
Code coverage alone does not prove test assertion strength. Code changes can pass tests while introducing logic regressions.

### Proposal
Integrate `cargo-mutants` running on PR diffs with `--in-diff`, rejecting PRs that leave generated mutants alive.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Mutation gate passes only if all mutant injections are caught by tests

title: engine: historical order book replay simulator for backtesting quoter strategies
body:
### Problem
Testing quoter rule modifications requires waiting for live market moves in real-time.

### Proposal
Build an offline backtest engine that ingests recorded Polymarket WebSocket tick logs and simulates quoter execution and PnL.

### Acceptance Criteria
- CLI tool replays tick file and prints simulated fills and reward score

title: core: zero-allocation JSON streaming parser for WebSocket book updates
body:
### Problem
Parsing WebSocket messages using `serde_json::Value` allocates dozens of heap strings per price tick.

### Proposal
Implement a zero-copy DOM-less parser using `simd-json` or custom deserializer borrowing directly from WebSocket frame buffers.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Benchmark proves zero heap allocations during price tick parsing

title: security: automated memory zeroization audit for all private key copies
body:
### Problem
While `Zeroizing` is used in `creds.rs`, intermediate strings during form deserialization could remain in heap memory.

### Proposal
Implement custom serde deserializer that parses private key directly into pinned mlocked zeroizing memory without temporary string buffers.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Memory scan confirms zero plaintext keys in process memory dump

title: engine: automatic dynamic pegging distance based on real-time bid-ask spread
body:
### Problem
Static distance (e.g. 2.0¢) becomes suboptimal when market spread widens or tightens dramatically.

### Proposal
Implement dynamic pegging algorithm that scales distance proportionally with current market spread while staying within reward score zones.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Distance adjusts dynamically based on spread expansion/contraction

title: core: distributed multi-node failover with Raft consensus
body:
### Problem
Running a single instance introduces a single point of failure if the host machine loses network connectivity.

### Proposal
Implement active-passive cluster leader election using Raft. Standby node monitors heartbeat and assumes quoting if leader fails.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Standby node assumes quoting within 10s of primary failure

title: engine: WebSocket connection multiplexing across multiple regional endpoints
body:
### Problem
A single WebSocket connection can experience routing jitter or packet loss.

### Proposal
Connect redundant WebSocket feeds across multiple geographic endpoints and deduplicate price messages using sequence numbers.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Drops latency spikes by consuming earliest arriving packet

title: security: hardware security module (PKCS#11 / AWS KMS) signing backend
body:
### Problem
Enterprise operators require key material to be non-exportable and stored in cloud HSM or Vault.

### Proposal
Abstract `Executor` signing behind a generic `Signer` trait supporting PKCS#11 and AWS KMS.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Signs EIP-712 orders via external KMS endpoint without local private key

title: core: formal verification of session store concurrency and eviction rules
body:
### Problem
Concurrent session creation, password rotation, and self-cleaning eviction could exhibit race conditions under high load.

### Proposal
Model `BoundedSessionStore` in TLA+ or Kani proving bounded memory ceiling and immediate invalidation on password change.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Formal specification verifies safety and liveness invariants

title: engine: auto-hedging inventory fills via opposite outcome market orders
body:
### Problem
When a resting BUY order fills, the user holds directional inventory exposure without automatic hedging.

### Proposal
Add optional 'Auto-Hedge' mode: upon detecting a fill on Token Yes, immediately submit limit sell or opposite buy within configured slippage.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Fill triggers immediate compensatory order on complementary token

title: core: eBPF network probe for microsecond CLOB latency telemetry
body:
### Problem
Application-level latency measurements include userspace scheduling jitter.

### Proposal
Provide an optional eBPF tracepoint program measuring kernel TCP socket latency to Polymarket endpoints.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Emits sub-millisecond network latency histograms

title: security: automated reproducible builds verification pipeline
body:
### Problem
Binaries built on different runners can produce divergent hashes due to timestamps or path prefixes.

### Proposal
Configure `SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH` and `cargo-rebuild` in CI, compiling on two independent runners and proving bit-for-bit identical SHA256 hashes.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Two distinct runner builds yield identical binary checksums

title: core: self-healing network partition recovery with state reconciliation
body:
### Problem
During split-brain network recovery, local order state may diverge from exchange order state.

### Proposal
Implement full state reconciliation protocol on reconnect: query exchange open orders, reconcile with local state, and prune ghost orders before resuming.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Automatically clears un-tracked ghost orders upon reconnect
